activation: first scheduled observer snapshot after this implementation is deployed; no historical snapshots are backfilled

implementation_pin.scope: v2 protocol and the shared immutable event/summary primitives

limitations: The bounded Gamma query-response union is selected and is not the venue-wide universe.
Stable controls were frozen from an earlier bounded discovery union and are not randomized against rotating markets.
The same-scan role comparison is descriptive; market composition and availability differ by role.
Intermittent public snapshots do not establish continuous coverage, quote lifetime, fills, or profitability.
Reported update timestamps do not establish venue sequence freshness, upstream queue age, or batch atomicity.
Repeated market and scan observations are dependent and are not independent trials.

observation_frame.rotating_selection: existing stratified phase rotation with recorded conditional inclusion probabilities
observation_frame.source: existing six-query bounded Gamma union and one batched public CLOB books read

primary_outcome.comparison: stable_random_control versus rotating_stratified roles within the same scheduled scan
primary_outcome.denominator: all selected pair slots; invalid and unavailable pairs remain in the denominator
primary_outcome.name: complete quality-valid paired-book yield per selected pair slot
primary_outcome.numerator: selected V1 same-condition pairs passing the existing finalized v4 request/receipt, identity, and paired-book quality checks
secondary_measurements: strict reported-age freshness sensitivity from the finalized v4 analysis event
verified batch atomicity and venue sequence counts

secondary_outcomes: per-scan and cumulative quality yield by role, phase, and selection stratum
distinct selected market IDs and market revisit counts
bounded discovery population, exclusions, missing controls, and skipped scan sequences
source response and analysis-event lineage for every included scan
observed candidate gate counts, without treating absence as a strategy result

window.missed_scans: remain visible as coverage gaps; do not extend the fixed elapsed-time window
